thread:
Maya Chen: Quick UX nit — updated the 'undo' toast after deleting an eval. Copy feels… aggressive. dropping here for quick review.
Liam O'Neill: Can you paste the current toast? or screenshot?
Maya Chen: current: `"Item deleted. Undo"` (single-action toast)
Zoe Park: hmm that reads like it happened instantly. Maybe `"Moved to Trash — Undo"`? clarifies it's reversible.
Ethan R: Agree. Also keyboard focus goes nowhere when toast appears — a11y problem. @design-bot can we log it?
design-bot: Created ticket #INFR-4321 for toast focus + screenreader announcement.
Liam O'Neill: I like `Moved to Trash — Undo` but want shorter label on button: `Undo` is fine. consider verb tense `Moved to Trash` vs `Deleted`.
Maya Chen: Proposed alternatives:
```
1) "Moved to Trash — Undo"
2) "Deleted — Undo"
3) "Removed from workspace — Undo"
```
Zoe Park: 1 feels safest. 3 is long for toast.
Ethan R: For SR: toast should call `aria-live="polite"` and the button should be reachable with Tab. Also announce 'Item moved to trash. Press Undo to restore.'
Maya Chen: Good call. Also how long should the toast persist? 6s feels short for keyboard users.
Liam O'Neill: Maybe 10s desktop, 14s for screen readers? Or keep 10s and allow hover/focus to extend.
Zoe Park: extend-on-focus is best.
Maya Chen: Final copy pick: `"Moved to Trash — Undo"` with SR announcement `"Item moved to trash. Press Undo to restore."` I'll update the PR. Thanks :heart:
Liam O'Neill: LGTM :thumbsup:
Ethan R: Filed a follow-up for analytics event on undo = true/false.
Maya Chen: Added notes to PR: focus + aria-live + extend-on-focus. Will ping when ready for dev review.
